clearLocalData.heading: Local data
clearLocalData.description: Fixes stuck locale names, bad vault cache, or bad onboarding state. Signs you out and clears IndexedDB (vault and manifest per locale), session tokens, compare sessions, and pending tags. Migration flag dac-storage-migrated-v1 is cleared only on a full reset.
clearLocalData.confirm:
Clear local app data and sign out?

This removes vault cache, manifest cache, Bungie/DIM tokens, compare sessions, and pending tags from this browser.
clearLocalData.confirmResetPrefs:
Also reset calibration preferences, dupe rules, onboarding, and the storage migration flag?

Choose OK for a full reset. Cancel keeps prefs, dupe rules, onboarding, and language choice.
